2608.02351.title: KC-Agent: A Dual-Process Cognitive Architecture for Efficient ML Model Improvement
2608.02351.paper_summary: Data drift poses significant challenges for machine learning systems in production, requiring continuous model updates to maintain performance. We present KC-Agent, a dual-process cognitive architecture for automated ML model improvement that combines fast pattern recognition (System 1) with deliberate incremental updates (System 2). Our approach implements structured memory systems enabling System 1 to leverage successful solutions previously discovered by System 2, achieving efficient pattern-based responses without costly re-computation. KC-Agent incorporates atomic change principles and rollback capabilities to ensure reliable, verifiable updates in production environments. We evaluate our method on five datasets including real-world NASA turbofan data with authentic temporal degradation and synthetic datasets with controlled drift scenarios. KC-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance (76.8% accuracy) while maintaining optimal efficiency (13.2s execution time), outperforming established cognitive architectures: CodeAct (+2.4%), Tree of Thoughts (+3.6%), ReAct (+8.0%), and Reflexion (+8.9%). Consensus evaluation by a panel of state-of-the-art LLMs confirms superior strategic efficacy (8.33/10 Smartness score), significantly outperforming baseline agents. The knowledge consolidation mechanism delivers 91% speedup over the slow variant while maintaining higher accuracy. Our approach demonstrates both theoretical foundations and practical viability for cognitive-inspired automated ML improvement systems capable of handling complex real-world data drift scenarios.
2608.02351.paper_summary_zh: 數據漂移對生產中的機器學習系統帶來了重大挑戰，需要持續的模型更新以維持性能。<lb/>我們提出了KC-Agent，一種雙過程認知架構，用於自動化機器學習模型的改進，結合了快速模式識別（系統1）與深思熟慮的增量更新（系統2）。<lb/>我們的方法實現了結構化記憶系統，使系統1能夠利用系統2之前發現的成功解決方案，實現高效的基於模式的反應，而無需昂貴的重新計算。<lb/>KC-Agent納入了原子變更原則和回滾能力，以確保在生產環境中進行可靠、可驗證的更新。<lb/>我們在五個數據集上評估我們的方法，包括具有真實時間退化的NASA渦輪風扇數據和具有可控漂移場景的合成數據集。<lb/>KC-Agent達到了最先進的性能（76.8%的準確率），同時保持最佳效率（13.2秒執行時間），超越了已建立的認知架構：CodeAct（+2.4%）、Tree of Thoughts（+3.6%）、ReAct（+8.0%）和Reflexion（+8.9%）。<lb/>由一組最先進的LLM進行的共識評估確認了其卓越的戰略效率（8.33/10的智能分數），顯著超越基準代理。<lb/>知識整合機制在保持更高準確率的同時，提供了91%的速度提升。<lb/>我們的方法展示了認知啟發的自動化機器學習改進系統的理論基礎和實際可行性，能夠處理複雜的現實世界數據漂移場景。
